brief: Regulator personnel intelligence for North Macedonia rests on a clean, legally mandated three-stage chain: a Government/Presidential public call or proposal (vlada.mk 'Јавен оглас за именување', pretsedatel), an Assembly committee and plenary decision (sobranie.mk, Комисија за прашања на изборите и именувањата), and final publication as an act in Службен весник — with NBRNM, KHV, ASO, MAPAS and the Deposit Insurance Fund all sharing that pipeline, which makes cross-checking straightforward. The most valuable diffable primaries are the NBRNM Council roster, Governor page, org chart and Конкурси vacancy page, plus the Ministry of Finance Financial System Sector page, which uniquely names the banking-and-payments unit head and deputy. Two caveats shape collection design: nbrm.mk and sobranie.mk returned HTTP 403 to plain fetches (bot defence suspected, not dead), so browser-context collection is likely required; and no structured feed or appointment register exists anywhere in the chain, so everything is snapshot-and-diff over HTML and gazette PDFs. The clearest blind spot is the sub-Council layer — no primary channel publishes directorate heads such as a payment-systems director, and Albanian-language sources were not covered in this pass.
